stem:
Gita asks whether roughage and water count in the diet if they are not called vitamins.

What should she decide?

options.text: Roughage and water are the same diet group as vitamins.
Roughage and water are essential diet components even though they are not vitamins.
Water counts in the diet only in some seasons.
Roughage can be skipped whenever the diet already has vitamins.

teacher.key_rationale: Roughage and water are still essential diet components, even though they are not vitamins.
